# Ramonyx

> Framework full-stack TypeScript (runtime MVP Node.js) dengan SSR React, hydration, soft navigation, keamanan bawaan, dan runtime Rust/V8 eksperimental. Disiplin bukti: setiap klaim punya ADR/test/benchmark.

Dokumentasi lengkap: https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/ . Fakta terstruktur (sumber kebenaran status/angka): https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/ .

## Machine-readable (sumber kebenaran fakta)

- [features.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/features.json): status setiap fitur (implemented/partial/experimental/planned) + paket + bukti + batasan
- [adrs.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/adrs.json): indeks 58 ADR — keputusan satu kalimat + relasi
- [rules.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/rules.json): aturan menulis aplikasi di atas Ramonyx, dengan contoh benar/salah
- [security.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/security.json): kontrol keamanan + status + celah yang diakui
- [glossary.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/glossary.json): istilah + peta konsep
- [stats.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/stats.json): versi, jumlah paket/ADR/test — satu-satunya tempat angka
- [api.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/api.json) dan [cli.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/cli.json): referensi API/CLI hasil ekstraksi kode
- [config.schema.json](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/machine/config.schema.json): bentuk ramonyx.config.ts (diverifikasi test)

- [sitemap.md](https://ramonyxjs.github.io/ramonyx/sitemap.md): indeks semua halaman
